evals.prompt: Build a settings page for my email notification app. I have a route at `app/routes/app.settings.tsx` with a loader returning `{settings: {emailEnabled: boolean, frequency: string, recipients: string[]}}` and an action handling form submission.
evals.expected_output: A React Router component using s-page, form with data-save-bar, s-section groups, s-switch for emailEnabled, s-select for frequency, s-text-field for recipients, useLoaderData() binding, useFetcher() for submission. No @shopify/polaris imports. Design tokens for spacing.

assertions.text: Form uses data-save-bar for Shopify save bar
Groups form fields in s-section components
Uses s-switch for boolean emailEnabled toggle
No inline styles - uses design tokens

evals.prompt: Create an index page showing all campaigns. Route `app/routes/app.campaigns.tsx` has a loader returning `{campaigns: Array<{id: string, title: string, status: 'active'|'paused'|'draft', sentCount: number}>}`.
evals.expected_output: A React Router component using s-page with size='large', primary action via slot='primary-action', s-search-field, s-table with s-badge for status, s-link on titles, compositional empty state, no s-title-bar.

assertions.text: Uses s-page size large for data-heavy page
Primary action via s-page slot, not s-title-bar
Does not use s-empty-state (component does not exist)

evals.prompt: Build the app homepage. Route `app/routes/app._index.tsx` has a loader returning `{metrics: {orders: number, revenue: number, conversionRate: number}, needsAttention: Array<{title: string, description: string, actionUrl: string}>}`.
evals.expected_output: A React Router component with s-grid responsive columns for metrics, s-section per metric, needs-attention list with actionable items, support footer links, loading skeleton state, responsive layout.

assertions.text: Uses s-grid for responsive metrics layout
Responsive columns for different screen sizes

evals.prompt: Build the frontend for my products page. The route is at `app/routes/app.products.tsx` — read the existing file and generate the UI.
evals.expected_output: Skill reads the existing route file to extract data shapes, generates UI matching the loader return type, wires useLoaderData() to real types, does not invent fields, uses breadcrumb-actions slot for back nav.

assertions.text: Does not use backAction prop (wrong API)
